landmarks.name: Munnar town
landmarks.note: the valley floor, where the aircraft takes off

landmarks.name: Anamudi
landmarks.note: the high ground to the north-east, about 235 m above the pad

landmarks.name: Meesapulimala
landmarks.note: the south-eastern peak, across the valley from Anamudi

landmarks.name: Chokramudi
landmarks.note: the nearer hill north of the town, with a 42 m relay mast on top

landmarks.name: the Pothamedu ridge
landmarks.note: the ridge behind the town, looking back over the estates

landmarks.name: Mattupetty Lake
landmarks.note: the reservoir held back by the dam, in the hollow between Chokramudi and Anamudi; the water sits about 65 m above the pad and there is nothing to hit over it

landmarks.name: the Mattupetty dam
landmarks.note: a 178 m wall across the neck of the valley, 48 m from its footing to its parapet

landmarks.name: Top Station
landmarks.note: the viewpoint on Anamudi's western slope, the highest thing you can land on

landmarks.name: the Kanan Devan tea estate
landmarks.note: terraced tea, with the factory at Nallathanni in the middle of it

landmarks.name: the shola forest
landmarks.note: a dense patch of native trees in the fold -- fly over it, not through it
